'''Noraz''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed at the [[Leth Outpost]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he asked an Imperial to retake [[Tromper Crags Geothermal Plant]] for the Empire.
